evals.prompt: I haven't touched this Maven project in a while. Can you check whether any of the dependencies in this pom.xml are out of date? Don't change anything yet — just tell me what's available.
evals.expected_output: Runs the Maven versions checks (including property updates so jackson/guava are caught), presents available updates grouped/labelled by major/minor/patch risk, filters pre-releases, and stops without editing the pom because the user asked report-only.

evals.prompt: are my npm packages outdated? if so go ahead and bump the safe (non-major) ones for me, leave the risky ones alone
evals.expected_output: Runs npm outdated, classifies updates by semver bump, applies only the non-major upgrades (e.g. axios/lodash patch/minor) via npm install, and explicitly leaves major bumps (e.g. react 17->18) unchanged while reporting them.

evals.prompt: what can I update in here? this is a spring boot service. show me everything then we'll decide together
evals.expected_output: Detects the Maven project, gathers all available updates, presents them grouped by risk with current->target versions, and waits for the user's selection before applying anything (asks which to apply).
